purpose: Authoritative Bun 1.4 comparison of faithful PERF-7v2 Candidate A / Direct against completed PERF-11v3.
non_goal: No BridgeViewNode-plus-FFI or other PERF-12 architecture was designed or implemented.
route_count_note: Timing runs intentionally disabled route counters to avoid candidate-specific hot-path instrumentation. A separate non-timing counter run is published in PERF-11v4-route-diagnostics.json.
limitations: The 10,000 normal-tree size was omitted from the full normal retained matrix because its cold/rebuilt 1,000-sample cost is not duration-sensible; 10,000 and 100,000 were included in the reduced-sample wide scaling matrix.
Component semantics are included in the full-schema parity and normal component workload; component identity is registered per isolated child.
